note: USGS Mars 2020 TRN HiRISE DTM mosaic (JEZ_hirise_soc_006, 1 m posting, blended from the in-crater HiRISE stereo DTMs incl. DTEEC_002387/045994/048842/023524), range-read and reprojected to an azimuthal-equidistant frame on the map anchor 18.47N 77.37E (R=3396190 m), averaged to 3 m. Exactly the 12 x 12 km game map (-6..6 km). Heights in m relative to the Mars areoid. The 1.9% mosaic gaps (north edge x -3..-2 km, south-west corner) are filled from the JPL CTX 20 m DEM with a smoothed offset match (scripts/jz_fill.py). A faint N-S mosaic seam runs at x = -4 km on the rim massifs.
